# BeatWave PC

BeatWave PC is the best music app for pc, built for bit-perfect WASAPI Exclusive Mode audio playback on Windows desktop. Developed by BeatLabs.

## Features
- **WASAPI Exclusive Mode**: Direct hardware audio bypass, bypassing the Windows system mixer for pure, unmodified audio.
- **Parametric EQ**: Lossless multi-band parametric equalizer that maintains the integrity of the original audio signal.
- **Cloud Sync**: Automated real-time library synchronization with the BeatWave Android companion app.
- **Local Sandbox**: Offline-first caching for zero-buffer playback.
- **Android Companion App**: Available at https://beatwavy.vercel.app.
